items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Her uncle, called him Turk, he was (unintelligible) used to play at the old Monogram Theater... Oh, he was a very good reader.

ctx.x: Her mother was a good reader too, because she played with those shows and circus too, and her uncle, called him Turk, he was (unintelligible) used to play at the old Monogram Theater had all these colored acts, and you had to
read all that stuff. Oh, he was a very good reader.
